title: Witch Hat Atelier
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: Coco, a village girl, dreams of becoming a witch, a path closed to ordinary people. After she discovers that magic is drawn with ink and accidentally turns her mother to stone with a forbidden spell, she becomes apprentice to the witch Qifrey and studies alongside other girls while a secret group of outlaw witches works in the shadows (from general knowledge, to verify).
life_message: Holds up patient study, honesty about mistakes and using one's gifts to help others, including those whom society leaves out.

content.note: Fights with outlaw witches and magical creatures; injuries shown (to verify).
Body horror from forbidden magic (AniList content signal) and a mother turned to stone; capped at 3 (to verify).
Guilt over her mother; a disabled boy's despair and rehabilitation (AniList Disability, Rehabilitation).
